name: Unofficial KAT-VR Companion App
summary:
This app provides ability to pair your treadmill with the sensors, and swap paired shoes without need to access to PC.

You could organize your sensors into pairs, and quickly swap the active shoes pair with the treadmill by quickly connecting the treadmill to your Quest device over USB.

**Note:** this app is only sets up the hardware and manages treadmill pairing with it sensors. This app is NOT a treadmill controller nor a game itself.
